sections.heading: C — Penalties and driving records

## C — Penalties and driving records

FACT_ID: sec14-F01 | anchor: A01
A driver license is a privilege that can be suspended, revoked or canceled for breaking the law. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec14-F02 | anchor: A01
Impaired driving is a listed example of conduct that can lead to losing a driver license. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec14-F03 | anchor: A01
Distracted driving is a listed example of conduct that can lead to losing a driver license. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec14-F04 | anchor: A01
Driving while the license is suspended or revoked can cause further loss of licensing privileges. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec14-F05 | anchor: A01
A minor-in-possession offense is another listed example that can cause license loss. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec14-F06 | anchor: A01
Personal-history information is one major category in a driving record. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec14-F07 | anchor: A01
Licensing information is a major driving-record category. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec14-F08 | anchor: A01
A driving record includes a major category covering conviction and accident history. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec14-F09 | anchor: A01
Driver-license sanctions form a major category in the driving record. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec14-F10 | anchor: A01
Motor-vehicle accident history is also listed as a major driving-record category. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec14-F11 | anchor: A01
The driving record keeps details of the person’s driver-license application. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec14-F12 | anchor: A01
The examination process is documented in the driving record. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec14-F13 | anchor: A01
The driving record includes the later issuance of a license. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec14-F14 | anchor: A01
A denial of a license is among the actions recorded in the driving record. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec14-F15 | anchor: A01
License revocation is among the licensing actions kept in the record. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec14-F16 | anchor: A01
License suspension is among the licensing actions kept in the record. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec14-F17 | anchor: A01
Cancellation of a license is included in the driving record’s licensing history. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec14-F18 | anchor: A01
The record also keeps information about driver performance and actions taken for unsafe performance or other legal requirements. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0093]

Misconceptions: Suspension, revocation and cancellation are separately named actions; this chapter does not supply a point threshold or a penalty duration.
Mnemonics: Authored cue: conduct, licensing action, recorded history.
Glossary: Suspension; revocation; cancellation; driver performance; licensing information; sanction.
